purpose: Defines the trace format the conformance harness expects from a live runtime system.

source_values.synthetic_vector: Trace generated from a test vector for validation purposes
source_values.live_runtime: Trace captured from actual system execution

normalization_rules: All traces must conform to non_collapse_runtime_trace.schema.json
Live traces must be normalized to the same schema before evaluation
Missing optional fields default to null, not false
integration_note: No live runtime trace integration is currently connected. This brief defines the contract for future integration. Live trace evaluation requires explicit authorization.
